name: next-steps-app
description: next-steps 跨介面版：每輪回答後建議最多三個下一步提示。終端機與桌面版顯示在輸入框上方，手機版與 VS Code 顯示在側邊面板；點選後填入輸入框成為草稿，不會自動送出。

author.name: Based on next-steps by Thariq Shihipar (MIT)

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has.

alwaysPane.title: Always use the side pane
alwaysPane.description: Show suggestions in a pane on every surface, not only where the above-prompt band is unavailable.
